authors: Jens Niedermeyer; Fabian Schlenker; Berend Denkena; Roland Lachmayer
name: luh-shape-errors-and-surface-roughnesses-of-specimens-with-support-and-stiffening-structures
notes: This dataset describes a study of specimens manufactured with different support and stiffening structures to reduce shape errors and surface roughnesses while milling of additively manufactured parts. The dataset includes CAD models, measurement data from a coordinate measuring machine, and the analysis of shape deviations and roughness values compared to simulation results and between the different structures.
